method.prohibitedKnowledge: No product parser or conversational grammar files read. Contract fixture functions were inspected only to reuse representable scientific object categories, explicit candidate lifecycle, and source/status conventions.
method.offline: No real provider requests; synthetic provider transport only at external adapter boundary.
method.languageGeneratorInput: This semantic file plus natural-language writing instructions only. No parser code, lexical routing rules, product repair changes or runtime pass/fail feedback before freeze.
method.expectedKnownSemantics: Per-turn known and unknown are semantic oracle metadata, not preloaded Project data or provider access to final state.
method.attributes: Structured attributes are oracle metadata. Their entire adopted meaning is also present in content because extraction contract does not expose arbitrary attributes.
method.languageInvariantEvidenceRequirement: Independent language artifact must add NEGATION, UNCERTAINTY, CONDITIONALITY, COMPARISON and TEMPORAL_RELATION arrays of verbatim userText segments of at most 240 characters; empty arrays when absent.
languageAdversarialRequirements: Distribute spelling mistakes, imperfect punctuation, short and long utterances across scenarios; preserve meaning.
Use natural references only with actual preceding referents except explicitly marked genuine ambiguity.
Do not copy semantic metadata into every user utterance; ordinary continuity should carry already adopted facts.
Multi-decision turns must remain one user message.
Reserve tentative wording for gold uncertainty or proposals; never accidentally strengthen ambiguous intent into adoption.
User utterance and subsequent review button are separate evidence phases. Do not fold UI confirmation into input if gold says NO_WRITE.
The same natural language can have different intent in different context; do not derive routing keyword tables.

syntheticLimitations: Provider extraction responses derived from frozen semantic gold cannot independently demonstrate live language understanding accuracy. LANGUAGE_UNDERSTANDING must be reported as SYNTHETIC_CONTRACT_ONLY for those turns, not live model validation.

Scientific usefulness can demonstrate relevant contribution, absence of contradiction, correct status and preserved uncertainty within this corpus; it cannot establish general scientific validity or PD011_PASS.

No synthetic fixture may inject OwnerResult, final Project, materialized candidate, runtime state, persistence receipt or QRY result. Transport must resolve replacement identity from current serialized real provider request.

Historical proposal references depend on content actually visible in earlier Standard output. Missing, ambiguous or obsolete proposals must never be invented by corpus or harness; report observed limitation or require clarification.

Conditional document or session capabilities are evaluated only through existing UI/runtime. Unavailable capability is PRODUCT_GAP / NOT_EVALUABLE, never a fabricated PASS and never authorization to build new product scope.
Human-review UI actions are explicit harness actions after input and semantic inspection. The candidate input alone never authorizes a Project write.
The semantic state model is intentionally not a final Project object and must only be used for assertions and external response fixtures.

Temporal graph coverage is explicitly limited: A01 includes a structured expected variable occasion three minutes after injection and an acquisition qualification J3-J6 after IDM replaced by J4-J7. Other calendars are tested as semantic properties of ENDPOINT/VISIT/ACQUISITION content; no blanket qualification of all temporal graph bindings is claimed.
requiredEvidence: Visible candidate before any human decision
Current Project identity version and digest before/after
Human decision receipt when adopted or rejected
oracle.goldCheckSemantics: mustContainCurrent/mustNotContainCurrent are semantic fact references, not mandatory exact wording. Resolve references to semanticDelta.content, attributes, role and epistemicState. Verify actual materialized Project independently; never use provider output as proof of correctness. beforeReviewCurrentMeaningByKey must be inspected after input before any review click.
